name: Chongqing Zhixin Indl Co. Ltd.
summary: Chongqing Zhixin Industrial Co., Ltd. is dedicated to the design, manufacturing, and distribution of automotive components produced through stamping and welding techniques, along with their related molds. The company's product portfolio includes: Cold-stamped parts: This category features items such as floor panels, taillight brackets, water flow channels, wheel hub packages, roof skylights, beam roofs, brake disc dust covers, heat shields, and bracket reinforcements. Thermoformed components: Their offerings here encompass door knockers, both coated and uncoated boards, plates with unequal thicknesses, and patch board varieties. Welded assemblies: These comprise front and rear longitudinal beams, wheel hub assemblies, floor assemblies, battery box covers, and CCB (steering support) units. Molds and tools: Their comprehensive tooling range covers thermoforming molds, transfers, 2D/3D molds, progressive dies, and connection molds, as well as necessary gauges and welding tools. Founded in 1995, the company is based in Chongqing, China.
